narrative.overview:
RCF Gestão is a plain, trustworthy ledger. The interface exists to put a number in front of a sócio and make clear where it came from, so the chrome is nearly invisible: white paper, near-black ink, hairline borders and a single grayscale family of surfaces. Nothing competes with the figures. The density is moderate. Tables, lists and indicator cards sit in a single 64rem column that reads comfortably on a laptop and collapses cleanly to one phone-width column for cost entry in the field.

Color is reserved for meaning. The logo's vivid blue, orange and magenta stay in the logo. Inside the app, blue means money coming in, orange means money going out, and red means a loss or an error. A screen with no money on it is grayscale.

The system is built on shadcn/ui (Base UI primitives, Tailwind 4) and stays close to its defaults on purpose: patterns the team already knows from every other web app, applied consistently. Brand lives in the precision of the numbers, not in decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Grayscale chrome. Color only on data and on negative results.
Figures in tabular numerals, right-aligned in tables, and formatted as BRL (`R$ 1.234,56`).
Bordered, flat containers with no resting shadows.
One centered column (max 64rem) with a sticky-free top bar that scrolls horizontally on small screens.
Light theme ships today. Dark tokens exist and must be kept correct, because dark mode is planned.

rules.name: The Color Means Money Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only on financial data (blue in, orange out, red loss) and on errors. Chrome, navigation, buttons and status never borrow the data hues or the logo's colors.

rules.name: The Red Is Loss Rule
rules.body: A negative number is always rendered in Loss Red, whether in a table, an indicator or a chart. Red is never used for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Every color added to `:root` gets a counterpart in `.dark` in the same change. Never hard-code a color that only works on white.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every money value, date and count uses `tabular-nums`, and money columns are right-aligned, so figures line up and can be compared at a glance.

rules.name: The Small Voice Rule
rules.body: Nothing is larger than 1.5rem. Importance comes from weight and position, not size.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a border, not a shadow. A container at rest never casts a shadow; only things that float above the page do.

dos: **Do** format money with `Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", { currency: "BRL" })` and set it in `tabular-nums`, right-aligned in tables.
**Do** render negative values in Loss Red everywhere they appear.
**Do** build containers from a hairline border and the 14px radius, and leave them flat.
**Do** keep the 64rem single column, and hide secondary table columns below `sm` rather than scrolling tables sideways.
**Do** add a `.dark` value whenever you add a `:root` token, and validate new chart hues against both backgrounds.
**Do** reuse `CabecalhoPagina`, `Secao`, `Indicador`, `Vazio`, `StatusEvento` and `FormAcao` before you create a new pattern.
donts: **Don't** bring the logo's blue, orange or magenta into buttons, nav, badges or backgrounds. Color means money.
**Don't** add resting shadows, gradients or decorative fills to cards or sections.
**Don't** set type above 1.5rem or introduce a second typeface.
**Don't** use red for anything except losses, errors and destructive actions.
**Don't** hard-code a hex color in a component, except chart series that are validated and commented in `graficos.tsx`.
